text_block_list.name: Shinobu
text_block_list.text:
So, it's you again...
You certainly do bear a powerful grudge.
text_block_list.orig_text:
またあなたですか……
怨念はかなり根深いようですね……

text_block_list.name: Miyako
text_block_list.text:
J-Jack looks extra strong this time!
Did being eaten lots of times make him crazy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
め、
めちゃくちゃ強そうなの！
食べられすぎておかしくなったの？

text_block_list.name: Shinobu
text_block_list.text:
This will not be an easy battle...
Miyako, we should give it everything we've got!
text_block_list.orig_text:
一筋縄ではいかなそうですね……
ミヤコさん、
気を引き締めて挑みましょう！
